info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Loyalty Loyalty Transfer-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Transfer Management API enables seamless transfer of loyalty points between members within a loyalty program. This API facilitates updates to loyalty point balances, ensuring that transactions are accurately reflected in real-time. Typically utilized by loyalty program administrators and customer support teams, this endpoint streamlines interactions between members and enhances customer satisfaction. By leveraging the capabilities of this API, organizations can effectively manage loyalty transfers, promoting engagement and retention strategies.

put.summary: Transfer loyalty points to another account.
put.description: This operation allows users to transfer loyalty points from their account to another user's account. Ensure that both accounts are valid and that the user has sufficient loyalty points available for transfer.

requestBody.description: This request is used to transfer loyalty points from one account to another. Ensure that the request body adheres to the specified schema for successful processing.
